from docx import Document
import datetime

# Load the provided template
template_path = '/mnt/data/993350fb28ac09d38ae6b9e1419080e5-FAR_Parts_6_and_13_5_JA.docx'
doc = Document(template_path)

# Helper: Replace all placeholder text in the document
def replace_placeholder(doc, placeholder, replacement):
    for p in doc.paragraphs:
        if placeholder in p.text:
            inline = p.runs
            for i in range(len(inline)):
                if placeholder in inline[i].text:
                    inline[i].text = inline[i].text.replace(placeholder, replacement)
    for table in doc.tables:
        for row in table.rows:
            for cell in row.cells:
                replace_placeholder(cell, placeholder, replacement)

# Section 1: Contracting Activity and Identification
section_1 = (
    "U.S. Army Contracting Command – Rock Island (ACC-RI), on behalf of Program Manager, Multi-Domain Sensor Integration (PMSI), "
    "intends to award a new firm-fixed-price contract (W52P1J-25-C-0038) to Aurora Defense Analytics LLC (CAGE 7K6R1) for sustainment of the SENTINEL FUSION NODE. "
    "This action is conducted under the authority of 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1) as implemented by FAR 6.302-1, Only One Responsible Source."
)

# Section 2: Nature and/or Description of the Action
section_2 = (
    "This action is for the sustainment of the SENTINEL FUSION NODE, a classified cross-domain analytics environment that ingests streaming sensor feeds from CENTCOM and EUCOM, "
    "fuses them with HUMINT/SIGINT holdings, and delivers decision-quality alerts to forward-deployed MDTFs. The node is hosted at Rock Island with reach-back to CONUS data centers. "
    "The contract will be a new firm-fixed-price contract with a base period from 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026, plus two 6-month options (1 April 2026 – 30 September 2027). "
    "Estimated value is $32.4M base plus $10.4M options, totaling $42.8M. Funding includes FY25 OMA (57 2040) and a small Procurement, Army (21 2031) line for gateway hardware refresh."
)

# Section 3: Description of Supplies/Services
section_3 = (
    "The SENTINEL FUSION NODE provides continuous, accredited cross-domain analytics for Multi-Domain Task Forces (MDTFs), supporting real-time fusion of streaming ISR, HUMINT, and SIGINT data. "
    "Sustainment includes: (1) operation and maintenance of the SENTINEL analytics runtime, (2) support for custom cross-domain connectors accredited by UCDSMO, (3) maintenance of machine-learning workflows approved by Army Cyber Command, "
    "(4) hardware refresh for gateway nodes, and (5) integration with the Mission Data Cloud and DISA-approved zero trust stack."
)

# Section 4: Statutory Authority
section_4 = (
    "This justification is made under the authority of 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1) as implemented by FAR 6.302-1, Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements."
)

# Section 5: Demonstration of Contractor’s Unique Qualifications
section_5 = (
    "Aurora Defense Analytics LLC is the only responsible source with the necessary Authority to Operate (ATO) and Authority to Connect (ATC) to operate SENTINEL across all three connected security domains. "
    "Aurora owns the SENTINEL analytics runtime, proprietary cross-domain connectors, and machine-learning workflows, all of which have passed UCDSMO and Army Cyber Command accreditation. "
    "The Government holds Government Purpose Rights to the training data but does not possess the source code for the analytics engine or streaming connectors. "
    "Recompeting before FY26 would require a 12–15 month recertification of all releasability and cyber accreditations, resulting in a coverage gap for MDTF operations. "
    "Any new vendor would need to rebuild the controlled cross-domain guards, re-ingest 27 PB of curated mission data, and retrain 134 ML workflows, which accrediting authorities estimate at 14–18 months. "
    "Aurora’s codebase already includes adapters for the new Mission Data Cloud and the DISA-approved zero trust stack. Rebuilding this stack would result in duplicative costs ($18M hardware, $11M labor) and lost ISR coverage. "
    "OSD has directed that there be no coverage gap for MDTF flash alerts; a lapse would force manual triage and degrade kill-chain timelines by 38 minutes per event (G3 briefing, 18 Nov 2024)."
)

# Section 6: Efforts to Obtain Competition
section_6 = (
    "Extensive market research was conducted:\n"
    "- 15 Oct 2024: Sources-sought on SAM.gov (Notice W52P1J-24-RFI-0931). Responses from Aurora Defense Analytics, Celerity Cyber Solutions, IronBridge DataWorks, and Northwind Mission Systems.\n"
    "- 05 Nov 2024: Technical interchange with Northwind, who lacked an accredited cross-domain guard and estimated 18 months to rebuild connectors.\n"
    "- 18 Nov 2024: Facility visit by Celerity, who could provide cleared staff but would need Aurora’s proprietary data schemas and ML playbooks to meet timelines.\n"
    "- 02 Dec 2024: RFI to DISA Cross Domain PMO confirmed Aurora is the only vendor with an active Interim Authorization to Test for SENTINEL-class workloads.\n"
    "Result: Only Aurora can meet the FY25 need-by date. Other sources could compete on the recompete if given data packages and more than a year for accreditation."
)

# Section 7: Actions to Increase Competition
section_7 = (
    "To increase future competition, the following actions are planned:\n"
    "- Feb 2025: Negotiate expanded Government Purpose Rights to analytics workflows and award the bridge FFP contract.\n"
    "- Apr 2025: Begin data package scrub so releasable training data, interface control documents, and zero-trust configs can be posted to prospective offerors (POC: PMSI Data Rights IPT).\n"
    "- Jul 2025: Release DRAFT RFP W52P1J-26-R-7001 with competitive range entry criteria.\n"
    "- Oct 2025: Issue FINAL RFP with a full 30-day proposal window; include Section H requirement for government-owned data pipelines.\n"
    "- Feb 2026: Award competitive follow-on with at least two offerors evaluated. Target competitive PoP start 1 Apr 2026."
)

# Section 8: Market Research
section_8 = (
    "Market research included a sources-sought notice (W52P1J-24-RFI-0931) on SAM.gov, technical interchanges, and facility visits. "
    "Aurora Defense Analytics demonstrated the only complete SENTINEL sustainment capability and validated cross-domain guards and ML workflows. "
    "Celerity Cyber Solutions could provide cleared staff but lacked proprietary adapters and would need 14 months to rebuild connectors. "
    "IronBridge DataWorks offered to migrate analytics into their ForgeLake platform but lacked Authority to Operate for TS/SCI cross-domain traffic. "
    "Northwind Mission Systems built a similar system for SOCOM but lacks Government Purpose Rights to SENTINEL data and needs 18 months for accreditation. "
    "DISA Cross Domain PMO confirmed only Aurora has an active Interim Authorization to Test for SENTINEL-class workloads."
)

# Section 9: Fair and Reasonable Cost Determination
section_9 = (
    "The Independent Government Cost Estimate (IGCE), prepared by the PMSI cost team on 17 Oct 2024, totals $43.2M (labor $34.3M; hardware refresh $8.9M). "
    "Aurora’s ROM proposal of $42.8M is within 1% of the IGCE. Proposed rates are consistent with the prior contract (W52P1J-21-C-0045) option year 3, with a 3.1% escalation using FY25 OSD inflation indices. "
    "A cost/price analyst will complete a cost realism memo using certified payroll data already on file."
)

# Section 10: Other Facts Supporting Use of Other Than Full and Open Competition
section_10 = (
    "Continuous SENTINEL coverage is required starting 1 April 2025. Army G-3/5/7 validated on 6 Dec 2024 that any break in SENTINEL coverage exceeds the acceptable risk threshold for INDOPACOM exercises. "
    "The current contract (W52P1J-21-C-0045) with Aurora Defense Analytics LLC expires 31 March 2025. "
    "Award target is 15 Feb 2025 to allow a 45-day transition overlap. "
    "Small business coordination: DD 2579 routed to PCR Ms. Heather Talbot on 01 Dec 2024, who concurred with full-and-open with J&A provided recompete milestones are published. "
    "SBS confirmed no small business could prime while security approvals remain proprietary to Aurora."
)

# Replace all "Insert ..." instructions and numbered sections
replace_placeholder(doc, "Insert contracting activity and identification of the agency and the contracting activity.", section_1)
replace_placeholder(doc, "Insert nature and/or description of the action being approved.", section_2)
replace_placeholder(doc, "Insert a description of the supplies or services required to meet the agency’s needs (including the estimated value).", section_3)
replace_placeholder(doc, "Insert statutory authority.", section_4)

replace_placeholder(doc, "Insert a description of efforts made to ensure offers are solicited from as many potential sources as is practicable.", section_6)
replace_placeholder(doc, "Insert a determination by the contracting officer that the anticipated cost to the Government will be fair and reasonable.", section_9)
replace_placeholder(doc, "Insert a description of the market research conducted and the results or a statement of the reason market research was not conducted.", section_8)
replace_placeholder(doc, "Insert any other facts supporting the use of other than full and open competition.", section_10)
replace_placeholder(doc, "Insert a statement of the actions, if any, the agency may take to remove or overcome any barriers to competition before any subsequent acquisition for the supplies or services required.", section_7)

# Save the completed document
output_path = '/mnt/data/2025-02-15_Sentinel_Fusion_Node_JA.docx'
